description: Lists the documents published for a UK bill, newest first: bill texts, explanatory notes, amendment papers, impact assessments, delegated powers memoranda and committee reports, with direct PDF and web links. For lawyers and policy staff after the latest bill text or notes. Source: UK Parliament Bills API. It returns links, not the document text; pair it with a URL or PDF reader to read one. (cost: 1 credit)

billId.description: integer, required, the Parliament bill ID (from bill_search), e.g. 3462

limit.description: integer, optional, documents to return 1-100, default 25

name: bill_documents
